name: RC-B10-0201/2026 – After § 11 – Am 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on ensuring accountability and justice in response to Russia’s continued attacks against the civilian population in Ukraine
part_text: 11a. Denounces Russia’s export of stolen grain from occupied areas of Ukraine and underlines that its confiscation may constitute a war crime; calls for immediate action to halt the export and trade of the illegally confiscated grain;
